convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMA for smoothed CHO) with standard parameters. Simple crossover entry/exit rules. Fixed lot or fractional position sizing. No external .mqh dependencies for trading logic.

indicators.name: CHO Smoothed (Chaikin Oscillator smoothed with MA)

derived_values.name: Smoothed CHO value (CHO line)
derived_values.formula: iCustom CHO(fast=3, slow=10) smoothed by EMA(period=10)
derived_values.used_by: Entry crossover signals and zero-line cross

derived_values.name: Digit-adjusted SL/TP
derived_values.formula: If _Digits==5 or _Digits==3, multiply pip values by 10
derived_values.used_by: Stop loss and take profit calculation

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one (close-and-reverse logic)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If LotSize is negative, use fixed lots equal to abs(LotSize). If LotSize is positive, treat as fractional percentage of free margin for position sizing.

custom_logic_notes: The CHO (Chaikin Oscillator) is computed using built-in iAC (Accelerator Oscillator) or iOsMA as a proxy, then smoothed with an EMA overlay. The EA uses a smoothed version of the Chaikin Oscillator where the raw CHO values are passed through an additional MA filter to reduce whipsaws. Entry requires both a crossover of the CHO line above/below its signal line AND the CHO line being above/below zero (confirmation filter). Opposite signals close existing positions before opening new ones. The LotSize input uses a sign convention: negative values = fixed lots, positive values = fraction of free margin.
python_conversion_notes: The CHO Smoothed indicator needs to be reimplemented in Python since there is no direct equivalent in common Python TA libraries. The Chaikin Oscillator can be computed from ADL (Accumulation/Distribution Line) as the difference between EMA(ADL, fast_period) and EMA(ADL, slow_period), then smoothed again with EMA(ma_period). Digit adjustment logic (multiplying SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be preserved. The conditional lot sizing (negative=fixed, positive=fraction) must be implemented carefully. New bar detection must be replicated using timestamp comparison. Signal confirmation requires both crossover AND zero-line check.
